title: La jerarquía
goal: Learn who you may and may not contradict
culture: The workshop has an order to it and none of it is written down. You do not walk up and start talking, you do not argue in front of a customer, and you do not decide anything that is not yours to decide. None of that is servility; it is how the place runs and everybody in it is protected by it.

beats.es: (Don Emilio está con un cliente. Usted necesita preguntarle algo.)
beats.good: You do not walk up and start talking. Con permiso is the knock on the door, and skipping it is the loudest thing you can do in a quiet workshop.

beats.objective: He has given you the floor — be brief
beats.say: Es sobre el trabajo del lunes.
ok: es sobre el trabajo del lunes
beats.good: Usted dirá means go on, I am listening. It is a small formality that tells you he is the one granting the turn — so take it and be short.

beats.es: Eso lo hacemos como siempre. No me lo cambie.
beats.good: Como usted diga is not servility. It closes a decision that was never yours, it costs nothing, and it is why he will listen next time you do have something.

beats.es: (Un cliente le pregunta a USTED si puede rebajarle el precio.)
beats.objective: Say it is not yours to decide
beats.say: No me toca a mí. Pregúntele a don Emilio.
beats.en: That’s not mine to decide. Ask don Emilio.
ok: no me toca a mi preguntele a don emilio
beats.good: No me toca — it is not mine to decide. It protects you and it points the customer at the one person who can actually answer him.
